title: PalawanPay Trilogy Marathon 2026 Cebu Leg Review: RUNRIO's 3AM Gun-Start Race
seo_title: PalawanPay Marathon Cebu 2026 Review | Mandaue Philippines
meta_description: The PalawanPay Trilogy Marathon 2026 Cebu Leg: September 27 in Mandaue City. 21K, 16K, 10K, 5K from RUNRIO with a 3AM gun start and registration open.
dek: Set for 27 September 2026 in Mandaue City, Cebu, this RUNRIO-produced PalawanPay series leg features a 3:00 AM gun start — one of the earliest flag-offs in Philippine road racing. Four distances with registration open.
verdict: The PalawanPay Trilogy Marathon Cebu Leg is a RUNRIO-produced race with a genuinely distinctive feature: a 3:00 AM gun start — one of the earliest flag-offs in Philippine racing, designed to get runners through before the Cebu heat peaks. Four distances (21K, 16K, 10K, 5K) with the unusual 16K mid-distance. Registration is open via Race Roster. The PalawanPay fintech sponsorship adds commercial backing to RUNRIO's gold-standard production. For runners wanting a well-produced Cebu half marathon with an ultra-early start and open registration, this is a strong pick.

sections.heading: 3AM: Beating the Cebu Heat
paragraphs: The 3:00 AM gun start is one of the earliest in Philippine road racing — a deliberate heat-management strategy for Cebu's tropical climate. [1] RUNRIO's production ensures professional timing and aid stations even in the pre-dawn hours. Mandaue City is part of the Cebu metropolitan area, with flat roads and good event infrastructure.
